cover.creator: <Creator>
cover.statistics_note: Login & Auth, Omnichannel Inbox, Knowledge Base, Lead Management, Content Pipeline, Agent Orchestration

environment:
1. Frontend: React + Vite (localhost:15876)
2. API Backend: .NET 8 (localhost:15874)
3. AgentService gRPC (localhost:15875)
4. SQL Server 2022 (Docker :1433)
5. Redis 7 (Docker :6379)
6. Qdrant vector store (Docker :6333)

sheets.name: Login & Authentication
sheets.requirement: JWT authentication with refresh-token rotation, 2FA, session revocation, password reset and change-password flows
sheets.precondition: API and database are reachable; a seeded tenant account exists

cases.description: Sign in with valid credentials
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/login with a valid email and password.
2. Check the response.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; response body contains accessToken and refreshToken.
cases.precondition: The account is active and no lockout is in effect

cases.description: Reject sign-in with a wrong password
cases.procedure: 1. POST /auth/login with a valid email and an incorrect password.
cases.expected: HTTP 401; no token is issued; generic error message returned.
cases.precondition: The account is active

cases.description: Lock the account after five consecutive wrong passwords
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/login with a wrong password five times.
2. Submit the correct password.
cases.expected: HTTP 429 or 401 on the sixth attempt; the correct password is also rejected until lockout expires.
cases.precondition: Lockout threshold is configured to five attempts
cases.note: Lockout window duration needs product-owner confirmation

cases.description: Refresh an access token using a valid refresh token
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/refresh with a valid refreshToken.
2. Check the response.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; new accessToken and rotated refreshToken are returned.
cases.precondition: A signed-in session exists with a valid refresh token

cases.description: Replay a refresh token after rotation is rejected
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/refresh to rotate the token.
2. Replay the original refresh token.
cases.expected: HTTP 401; the replayed token is rejected (rotation invalidates the previous token).
cases.precondition: A signed-in session exists

cases.description: Sign out revokes the refresh token
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/logout.
2. Attempt to use the previous refresh token.
cases.expected: Logout returns HTTP 200; the revoked refresh token is rejected with HTTP 401.
cases.precondition: An active session exists

cases.description: Enable 2FA and verify the setup TOTP code
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/2fa/enable to get the TOTP secret.
2. POST /auth/2fa/verify with a valid TOTP code.
cases.expected: 2FA is enabled on the account; subsequent logins require a TOTP step.
cases.precondition: Account does not have 2FA enabled

cases.description: Complete login with a valid TOTP code when 2FA is active
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/login to receive a partial token.
2. POST /auth/login/2fa with the current TOTP code.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; full accessToken and refreshToken are returned.
cases.precondition: 2FA is enabled on the account

cases.description: Reject login with an incorrect TOTP code
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/login to receive a partial token.
2. POST /auth/login/2fa with an invalid TOTP code.
cases.expected: HTTP 401; no full token is issued.
cases.precondition: 2FA is enabled on the account

cases.description: Change password while signed in
cases.procedure:
1. POST /auth/change-password with the current and new passwords.
2. Sign out and sign back in with the new password.
cases.expected: Password change returns HTTP 200; old password is no longer accepted.
cases.precondition: An active session exists

cases.description: Request a password reset email
cases.procedure: 1. POST /auth/reset/request with the account email.
cases.expected: HTTP 200 is returned regardless of whether the email exists (no user enumeration).
cases.precondition: SMTP is configured in the test environment

cases.description: Confirm a password reset with a valid token
cases.procedure:
1. Extract the reset token from the email link.
2. POST /auth/reset/confirm with the token and new password.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; the user can sign in with the new password; the reset token cannot be reused.
cases.precondition: A valid reset token was issued within the expiry window

sheets.name: Omnichannel Inbox
sheets.requirement: Channel connection, message ingestion via webhook and polling, deduplication, outbound replies, auto-reply with AI, pause/resume, draft approval, escalation and conversation search
sheets.precondition: At least one channel is connected; RabbitMQ consumer is running

cases.description: Connect a channel with a valid page token
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/admin/inboxes with a valid page token.
2. Wait for the first sync to start.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; channel is listed as connected; initial conversation sync begins.
cases.precondition: A valid page token is available

cases.description: Reject a channel connection with an invalid token
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/admin/inboxes with an invalid token.
cases.expected: HTTP 422; no inbox row is persisted; error message is returned.
cases.precondition: None

cases.description: Reconnect a channel after the token is revoked
cases.procedure:
1. Revoke the token at the provider.
2. PUT /api/admin/inboxes/{id} with a new token.
cases.expected: Sync error is cleared; message ingestion resumes for new messages.
cases.precondition: The channel is currently connected

cases.description: Conversations from different tenants remain isolated
cases.procedure:
1. Connect the same page under two tenants.
2. Send a message.
cases.expected: The message appears only in the correct tenant inbox.
cases.precondition: Two active tenant accounts exist

cases.description: Ingest an inbound message through the webhook
cases.procedure:
1. POST a valid signed webhook payload to the Pancake webhook endpoint.
2. GET /api/inbox/conversations/{id}.
cases.expected: The message appears in the conversation within a few seconds.
cases.precondition: Webhook secret is configured; HMAC signature is valid

cases.description: Reject a webhook payload with an invalid HMAC signature
cases.procedure: 1. POST a webhook payload with a tampered x-pancake-signature header.
cases.expected: HTTP 401; the message is not stored.
cases.precondition: Webhook secret is configured

cases.description: Ingest a message through polling when the webhook is unavailable
cases.procedure:
1. Disable the webhook.
2. Send a message from the channel.
3. Wait for the next polling cycle.
cases.expected: The message is ingested by the polling worker and appears in the inbox.
cases.precondition: Polling is enabled and the channel token is valid

cases.description: Deduplicate a message delivered by both webhook and polling
cases.procedure:
1. Enable both ingestion paths.
2. Send a single message from the channel.
cases.expected: Exactly one message record is stored.
cases.precondition: Both ingestion paths are active

cases.description: Keep the queue intact when the consumer restarts
cases.procedure:
1. Stop the RabbitMQ consumer.
2. Send two messages.
3. Start the consumer again.
cases.expected: Both messages are processed after restart; none is lost.
cases.precondition: RabbitMQ persistence is enabled
cases.note: One message stayed unacked until the next cycle; tracked in backlog

cases.description: Send a manual outbound reply
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/messages with a text body.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; reply is delivered to the channel and shown as outbound.
cases.precondition: The conversation is open and assigned

cases.description: Auto-reply answers a question covered by the knowledge base
cases.procedure:
1. Enable auto-reply via POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/ai.
2. Send an inbound message matching a KB topic.
cases.expected: An accurate automatic reply is sent within the SLA window.
cases.precondition: Auto-reply is enabled; KB is deployed

cases.description: A manual reply by an agent pauses auto-reply
cases.procedure:
1. Confirm auto-reply is enabled.
2. Send a manual reply as an agent.
3. Send a new inbound message immediately.
cases.expected: Auto-reply does not respond during the configured pause window (default 5 min).
cases.precondition: Auto-reply is enabled

cases.description: Auto-reply resumes automatically after the pause window elapses
cases.procedure:
1. Trigger a pause by sending a manual reply.
2. Advance the clock past the pause window.
3. Send a new inbound message.
cases.expected: Auto-reply answers the new message without manual intervention.
cases.precondition: A pause was triggered; the sweep job is running

cases.description: Escalate a conversation disables auto-reply permanently
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/escalate.
cases.expected: Auto-reply is disabled and resume_at is null; conversation is flagged as escalated.
cases.precondition: Auto-reply is enabled

cases.description: Approve an AI draft and confirm it is sent
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/drafts/{messageId}/approve.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; draft is sent to the channel; status changes to delivered.
cases.precondition: A pending AI draft exists

cases.description: Reject an AI draft so it is not sent
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/drafts/{messageId}/reject.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; draft is discarded; no outbound message is delivered.
cases.precondition: A pending AI draft exists

cases.description: Assign a conversation to a different agent
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/assign with a target agentId.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; the new agent sees the conversation in their queue.
cases.precondition: A second agent account exists

cases.description: Resolve a conversation
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/resolve.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; status changes to resolved; removed from the open queue.
cases.precondition: The conversation is open

cases.description: Search conversations by keyword
cases.procedure: 1. GET /api/inbox/search?q={keyword}.
cases.expected: Only conversations whose messages contain the keyword are returned.
cases.precondition: Several conversations with varied message content exist

cases.description: Export conversation history to CSV
cases.procedure: 1. GET /api/inbox/conversations/{id}/export.csv.
cases.expected: HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/csv; file contains all messages in order.
cases.precondition: The conversation has at least one message

sheets.name: Knowledge Base
sheets.requirement: KB module management, version creation, content deploy to vector store, rollback, accuracy measurement and auto-approving AI suggestions when accuracy does not decrease
sheets.precondition: Qdrant vector store is reachable; a configured LLM provider is active

cases.description: Create a knowledge base module
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/kb/modules with a name and description.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; module is created with status draft.
cases.precondition: User holds kb:write permission

cases.description: Archive a module removes it from retrieval
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/kb/modules/{id}/archive.
2. Ask a question that was answered by that module.
cases.expected: The archived module is excluded from all retrieval results.
cases.precondition: Module is deployed and active

cases.description: Create a new version with Markdown content
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/kb/modules/{id}/versions with contentMd.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; version is created in draft state; chunk count is zero until deployed.
cases.precondition: Module exists

cases.description: Deploy a version embeds chunks into the vector store
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/kb/modules/{id}/versions/{versionId}/deploy.
2. Wait for the deploy job to finish.
cases.expected: Chunk count is greater than zero; module status changes to deployed.
cases.precondition: A draft version with content exists; Qdrant is reachable

cases.description: Rollback to the previous deployed version
cases.procedure:
1. Deploy version 2.
2. POST /api/kb/modules/{id}/versions/{v1id}/rollback.
cases.expected: Version 1 becomes active; retrieval uses version 1 chunks.
cases.precondition: At least two deployed versions exist

cases.description: Run the accuracy test suite on a deployed version
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/kb/modules/{id}/versions/{versionId}/test.
cases.expected: Each test case is evaluated; an overall accuracy score is returned.
cases.precondition: Test cases exist; the version is deployed

cases.description: Auto-approve a KB suggestion when accuracy does not decrease
cases.procedure:
1. Create a suggestion with verdict=approve and accuracy_after >= accuracy_before.
2. Trigger the auto-approve job.
cases.expected: Suggestion is automatically approved and applied without human action.
cases.precondition: Auto-approve rail is enabled; suggestion status is pending

cases.description: Hold a KB suggestion for human review when accuracy decreases
cases.procedure:
1. Create a suggestion with verdict=approve and accuracy_after < accuracy_before.
2. Trigger the auto-approve job.
cases.expected: Suggestion is NOT auto-approved; stays in pending state waiting for human decision.
cases.precondition: Auto-approve rail is enabled; suggestion status is pending

sheets.name: Lead Management
sheets.requirement: Lead CRUD, pipeline stage transitions driven by score, manual stage override, scoring rule management, lead assignment and activity feed
sheets.precondition: API is running; lead scoring rules are seeded via POST /api/lead-scoring-rules/seed-defaults

cases.description: Create a lead from a contact
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/leads with contactId, source and assignedTo.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; lead is created with stage=cold; initial score is 0.
cases.precondition: A contact exists; user holds leads:write permission

cases.description: List leads with pagination and stage filter
cases.procedure: 1. GET /api/leads?stage=warm&page=1&pageSize=20.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; only leads with stage=warm are returned; pagination metadata is present.
cases.precondition: Multiple leads exist across different stages

cases.description: Assign a lead to another sales agent
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/leads/{id}/assign with the target agentId.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; assignedTo is updated; the new agent sees the lead in their queue.
cases.precondition: A second agent account exists

cases.description: Score increases when a purchase_intent activity is recorded
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/leads/{id}/activities with eventCode=purchase_intent.
cases.expected: Lead score increases by the purchase_intent delta (default +20); stage may advance to hot.
cases.precondition: Lead scoring rules are seeded; lead is cold

cases.description: Pipeline stage advances automatically when the score threshold is crossed
cases.procedure:
1. Record activities until the score reaches 70.
2. GET /api/leads/{id}.
cases.expected: stage=hot (score >= 70); previous warm stage is no longer shown.
cases.precondition: Lead scoring rules give enough delta per event

cases.description: Re-score a lead using the latest rules
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/leads/{id}/rescore.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; score is recalculated using the current rule set; stage is updated accordingly.
cases.precondition: Lead scoring rules have been modified since the lead was created

cases.description: A lost lead is reactivated when new inbound activity arrives
cases.procedure:
1. Mark the lead as lost.
2. POST /api/leads/{id}/activities with any inbound event.
cases.expected: Lead status changes from lost to active; LastActivityAt is updated.
cases.precondition: A lost lead exists

cases.description: Seed default scoring rules for a tenant
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/lead-scoring-rules/seed-defaults.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; default rules are created (asked_price, purchase_intent, fast_reply etc.); each has the correct default delta.
cases.precondition: No rules exist for the tenant yet

cases.description: Create a platform-specific rule that overrides the platform-null rule
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/lead-scoring-rules with eventCode=asked_price and platform=facebook and delta=15.
2. Record asked_price on a facebook conversation.
cases.expected: The facebook-specific rule (delta=15) is used instead of the platform-null rule (delta=9).
cases.precondition: A platform-null asked_price rule already exists

sheets.name: Content Pipeline
sheets.requirement: Brief management, AI content generation, review gate, human approval, scheduling and publishing lifecycle for social media posts
sheets.precondition: A configured LLM provider is active; a deployed KB module exists for RAG context

cases.description: Create a content brief
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/content/briefs with platform, topic and target audience.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; brief is created in draft state.
cases.precondition: User holds content:write permission

cases.description: Generate a content item from a brief
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/content/items/generate with briefId.
cases.expected: HTTP 202; a background job is queued; polling shows the item transitions to draft with a non-empty body.
cases.precondition: A brief exists; LLM provider is configured

cases.description: Generation is blocked when the body contains an absolute guarantee phrase
cases.procedure:
1. Configure the LLM stub to return a body that contains an absolute-guarantee phrase.
2. Trigger generation.
cases.expected: The content lint step fails; item status becomes needs_human with ErrorCode=lint_absolute_guarantee.
cases.precondition: ContentLint is enabled; LLM stub is available

cases.description: Agent review passes and item moves to approved
cases.procedure: 1. Wait for the AI reviewer agent to process the draft item.
cases.expected: AgentReviewStatus=passed; item is eligible for human approval or auto-publish depending on policy.
cases.precondition: A reviewer agent is configured and bound to an LLM

cases.description: Human approves an item that requires human review
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/content/items/{id}/approve.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; item status=approved; ApprovedAt and ApprovedBy are set.
cases.precondition: Item is in needs_human state with agent review passed

cases.description: Human rejects an item with a reason
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/content/items/{id}/reject with a reason string.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; item status=rejected; RejectedReason is stored.
cases.precondition: Item is in draft or needs_human state

cases.description: Schedule an approved item for a future golden-hour slot
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/content/items/{id}/schedule with a future publishAt timestamp.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; item status=scheduled; publishAt is stored.
cases.precondition: Item is approved

cases.description: Repurpose a published item for a different platform
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/content/items/{id}/repurpose with targetPlatform.
cases.expected: HTTP 202; a new draft item is created for the target platform; the original item is unchanged.
cases.precondition: The item has been published; a brief exists for the target platform

sheets.name: Agent Orchestration
sheets.requirement: Create and run orchestration sessions, pause for manual intervention, resume after approval, manage recurring schedules and verify agent tool grants
sheets.precondition: AgentService gRPC is running; at least one agent definition is bound to an LLM provider

cases.description: Create and start an orchestration run
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/orchestration/runs with a planId.
2. Poll GET /api/orchestration/runs/{id} until status=running.
cases.expected: Run transitions from queued to running; agent tasks begin executing.
cases.precondition: A plan exists; agents are bound to LLM providers

cases.description: Pause a running session for manual intervention
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/orchestration/runs/{id}/pause.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; run status=paused; no new tasks are started.
cases.precondition: A run is in running status

cases.description: Intervene by editing a task output then resume the run
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/orchestration/runs/{id}/intervene with an edited taskId and new output.
2. POST /api/orchestration/runs/{id}/resume.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; the run resumes with the edited output; downstream tasks use the corrected data.
cases.precondition: Run is paused

cases.description: Cancel a running session
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/orchestration/runs/{id}/cancel.
cases.expected: HTTP 200; run status=cancelled; all pending tasks are marked skipped.
cases.precondition: A run is in running or paused status

cases.description: Create a recurring weekly schedule
cases.procedure: 1. POST /api/orchestration/schedules with cadence=weekly and a valid timezone.
cases.expected: HTTP 201; schedule is created; nextRunAt is set to the correct window in the given timezone.
cases.precondition: A plan exists

cases.description: Pause and reactivate a schedule
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/orchestration/schedules/{id}/pause.
2. POST /api/orchestration/schedules/{id}/activate.
cases.expected: Pause: status=paused, no new runs are triggered. Activate: status=active, nextRunAt is recalculated.
cases.precondition: An active schedule exists

cases.description: An agent without tool grants cannot call restricted tools
cases.procedure:
1. Create an agent definition with no tool grants.
2. Start a run that requires a restricted tool.
cases.expected: The tool call is blocked; the agent task fails with a permission error; the run does not crash.
cases.precondition: A restricted tool exists in the tool registry

cases.description: Grant a tool to an agent and confirm the tool call succeeds
cases.procedure:
1. POST /api/orchestration/agents/{id}/grants with the tool name.
2. Restart the run.
cases.expected: The tool call succeeds; the run completes the task.
cases.precondition: TC-ORC-007 has been completed
